Domain check {{ domainType }}
The domain check compares your email domain against a list of common personal email providers. It is a heuristic on the address only, not a business registry check, so it never confirms that a company exists or that you work there.
Verified record access
Requesting the candidate's verified record is a separate step, and the candidate decides whether to allow it. If they approve, you receive one of two things, depending on what they have on file: a comparison of their verified record with your copy (the items they confirmed that Verifi has verified, and the name and status of any item that was checked and did not clear), or a status report of their licenses.
Your name, company, and confirmed email are shown to the candidate with the request, along with how you say you obtained their information. Requests close after 72 hours without an answer.
